sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, os, re, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import Counter
today = date(2025,8,12)
levels = ['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']
periods = {
 'today': (today, today),
 'last_7_days': (today-timedelta(days=6), today),
 'last_30_days': (today-timedelta(days=29), today),
 'month_to_date': (date(today.year,today.month,1), today),
 'total': None,
}
counts = {p: Counter() for p in periods}
for f in glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'):
    m = re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_', os.path.basename(f))
    if not m: continue
    d = date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    with open(f, errors='ignore') as fh:
        for line in fh:
            mm = re.search(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]', line)
            if not mm: continue
            lv = mm.group(1)
            for p, rng in periods.items():
                if rng is None or rng[0] <= d <= rng[1]:
                    counts[p][lv]+=1
with open('/app/summary.csv','w',newline='') as out:
    w=csv.writer(out)
    w.writerow(['period','severity','count'])
    for p in periods:
        for lv in levels:
            w.writerow([p,lv,counts[p][lv]])
print(open('/app/summary.csv').read())
PY
EOF
